document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Early in the morning, the nostrils of the camels steam in the 
chill desert air. You consume welcome cups of strong coffee and 
milk. As the caravan moves out, you are mostly ignored. Once 
in a while someone shouts something, which you imagine refers 
to you, but you never understand the words. That night, wrapped 
in your loneliness, you sleep a little apart from the others. In 
the morning you wake with a start. The caravan has—perhaps 
accidentally? —left you behind. Go to 94. 
(319, 361, 384)
